changes.title: Partial port of vLLM PR 779: Qwen HC ownership and checkpoint coalescing

changes.title: Export prepared PLE internal prefill checkpoints
changes.note: The two commits match the head commits of the open B12X PR 386 (087b15b326a5, 8801c016c429) and supply the export_checkpoint API Qwen coalescing calls. The paired prepared-launcher and collective-preparation work reached the beta base through merge 748fa9ea94f2 and native MXFP8 W8A8 MoE through merge 914921dad15d, so this branch no longer carries either.
